summary: Lead research for SBDC Learning Modules MVP (small business education/training platform). Targets Ohio SBDC offices, entrepreneurial education organizations, and business training programs that could benefit from modular, self-paced learning content.

leads.organization: Ohio Small Business Development Centers (Statewide Network)
leads.fit_rationale: Leading resource for Ohio entrepreneurs offering no-cost consulting and training. Modular learning platform would complement their existing workshop programs and extend reach.
Ashtabula-based nonprofit focused on entrepreneurial education since 2011. Provides workshops and coaching. Digital learning modules would expand their educational offerings.

leads.organization: Ohio SBDC at Terra State Community College
leads.fit_rationale: Serves Erie, Ottawa, Sandusky and Seneca Counties with advising and training since 1988. Online learning modules would support their entrepreneurial training programs.
Promotes business education through scholarships, mentorship, and information sharing. Learning modules would support their mission to educate the business community.
Provides virtual trainings across 13-county service region. Modular learning platform would enhance their training delivery and track learner progress.

branding_quality_assessment.notes: No visual-analysis JSON available yet; branding/layout assessment deferred until screenshot analysis report exists.

site_improvements: Add progress tracking and completion certificates for each module.
Include interactive quizzes and knowledge checks within modules.
Create learning paths for different business stages (startup, growth, expansion).
Add downloadable resources and templates (business plan templates, financial worksheets).
Integrate discussion forums for peer learning and networking.
Provide Spanish language modules for broader accessibility.
Add advisor scheduling integration for learners needing one-on-one help.
Include case studies featuring local Ohio business success stories.

possible_issues: Educational platforms need clear navigation—confusing module organization frustrates learners.
Dense text without visual breaks reduces engagement and completion rates.
Missing progress indicators may cause learners to lose motivation.

whitelabel_potential.reason: Learning management platforms are highly white-labelable for different SBDC offices, community colleges, or economic development organizations with custom branding.

action_next: Merge visual-analysis findings once the screenshot report exists.
Contact Ohio SBDC state office about piloting modular learning content.
Reach out to NEO Fund about digital education partnership.
Explore integration with existing SBDC advising workflows.
